# Enterprise Tasks

> Enterprise Tasks is a Laravel 13 application for private personal task management with a separate, role-protected administrative workspace. Personal task data is owner-scoped; administrative mutations are auditable.

## Public pages (indexable)

- `/` (guest home): product overview, value proposition, and entry points to sign in or register.
- `/about`: product story, mission, and principles.
- `/capabilities`: overview of the four product capabilities.
- `/capabilities/task-capture`, `/capabilities/progress-tracking`, `/capabilities/secure-apis`, `/capabilities/administrative-governance`: dedicated capability pages.
- `/blog`: product and operational-practice journal.
- `/blog/{post}`: individual journal articles.
- `/faq`: frequently asked questions.
- `/terms`: terms of service.
- `/privacy`: privacy policy.
- `/cookie-policy`: cookie policy and choices.

## Account access forms (noindex, nofollow)

- `/login`, `/register`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password/{token}`, `/verify-email`
- `/admin/login`: staff entry point.

## Operational endpoints

- `/healthz`: liveness probe.
- `/readyz`: readiness probe.
- `/sitemap.xml`: indexable public URLs.
- `/robots.txt`: crawler directives.
- `/llms.txt`: this document for LLM crawlers.

## Authenticated application (not indexable)

- `/dashboard`: private personal task workspace.
- `/tasks`, `/tasks/create`, `/tasks/{task}`, `/tasks/{task}/edit`: owner-scoped task management.
- `/profile`: account and security settings.
- `/api/tasks`, `/api/user`: Sanctum-protected endpoints scoped to the authenticated task owner.

## Administrative workspace (not indexable)

- `/admin/dashboard`, `/admin/stats`: role-protected operational overview.
- `/admin/tasks`, `/admin/tasks/{task}/...`: moderation, status, reassignment, restoration, bulk action.
- `/admin/users`, `/admin/users/{user}/...`: user management, suspension, role removal.
- `/admin/settings` (super_admin): system-wide configuration.
- `/admin/audit-logs`, `/admin/audit-logs/export` (super_admin): recorded administrative activity history.
- `/api/admin/*`, `/api/v1/admin/*`: Sanctum-protected administrative endpoints.

## Boundaries

- Personal task reads and writes are scoped to the authenticated task owner.
- Admin authorization is role-based (`admin`, `super_admin`, `moderator`) and distinct from personal task flows.
- All administrative mutations are recorded in `audit_logs`.
- `/dashboard`, `/profile`, `/admin/`, `/api/`, and the auth flows are `noindex,nofollow`.
- The canonical authorization source is the `role` relationship; the legacy `is_admin` flag is compatibility-only.

## Stack

Laravel 13, PHP 8.5, Blade, Livewire 4, Alpine.js (via Livewire), Tailwind CSS 4, Vite, SQLite by default, Sanctum, PHPUnit.
